title: A refused action writes no row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser (you are signed in as an Admin in the first).
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Start with the Credit Terms page open in both browsers.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. In user B's browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  4. In user B's browser, click "Make Default for New Customers".
  5. In user B's browser, click "Make Default".
  6. In your browser, click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  7. Click "Cancel".
  8. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  9. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • User B's menu opens.

Step 4:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 5:

  • User B sees "term A is now the default".

Step 6:

  • The alert "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." shows.

Step 7:

  • The confirmation closes.

Step 8:

  • The menu opens.

Step 9:

  • The newest row is user B's "Default changed"
  • There is no "Credit term deleted" row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R7: “A row is written only when a change is saved. A refused or canceled action (the error handling of Stories 2, 3 and 4, or Cancel) writes nothing, and neither does an action that changes nothing (for example making the current default the default again).”
